game.name: Battlefield : Hardline (USA, Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt,Pl,Ru)(Disc 1)(Install-Multiplayer)
game.desc: Battlefield Hardline is a first-person shooter for 360 that offers several game modes. In the single player mode, players can experience a dark, crime series-inspired storyline, but they can also participate in multiplayer battles where they must choose sides and complete their mission in cooperation with other team members.
